hook: Slowing or rerouting ships around whale shark hotspots costs little fuel on most long voyages.
hook_turn: costs little fuel on most long voyages.
summary: Simulating eight port-to-port trips for a tanker and a container ship, the authors compared normal routes, a 10 knot limit in whale shark habitat, and full avoidance. Fuel use changed by -0.13% to 9.65%, under 1% for most long trips. Speed limits suited short voyages and avoidance suited long ones. Results are simulations for eight routes and do not measure actual strike reduction.
title: Optimizing voyages for biodiversity: rerouting vessels around ocean giants can have minimal impact on shipping.
